budgets.note: Targets only. Renderer must frustum-cull and select LOD, then report actual counts; not all stored triangles are submitted each frame.

provenance.method: Original authored terrain and procedural polygon models. No video, no precalculated camera, no external assets. ASTRILLA mesh/G3D1 conventions inspected for compatibility; none of its illustrated panoramas used as scenery.

animated_models.note: Only rest geometry and local rotation pivots. Runtime motion derives from gameplay distance/time, not a stored animation or camera sequence.
